M-LINT.NAME: Enforced invariants (lint)
M-LINT.purpose: Enforce MyGRACE invariants: XML validity, index/entity drift, path and dependency integrity, caps/budgets and markup discipline.

fn-analyzeMarkup.PURPOSE: Text-markup analysis shared with file show (contract fields, name-aware block pairing).

fn-lintXmlFiles.PURPOSE: Structural XML validity plus index-root and entity-tag checks for every docs/*.xml.

fn-lintIndexSync.PURPOSE: Index to entity sync, field drift, PATH existence and DEPENDS integrity for one flat index.

fn-lintGraphIndex.PURPOSE: Shard-aware graph-index validation: flat entries plus <Shard> refs (ADR-6).

fn-lintIndexCaps.PURPOSE: Index line caps from mygrace.config.json (errors above cap).

fn-lintEntityBudgets.PURPOSE: Entity line budgets from config (warnings outside the range).

fn-lintVerificationRefs.PURPOSE: Verification ref integrity in both directions, all refs.

fn-lintMarkup.PURPOSE: Semantic markup over configured source dirs with name-aware block pairing.

fn-collectLintIssues.PURPOSE: Aggregate every detector; backwards compatible 2-arg form for status/doctor.

export-lintCommand.PURPOSE: citty command with --strict, --format, --allow-missing-docs and the incremental --changed/--base/--files scope.

type-Finding.PURPOSE: Re-exported finding shape used by every detector.

contract.purpose: Enforce MyGRACE invariants: XML validity, index/entity drift, path and dependency integrity, caps/budgets and markup discipline.

param.name: findings
param.description: Coded findings with stable severity and location.

error.description: Duplicate entity id in an index.
Declared module PATH does not exist.
DEPENDS target missing from the index.

notes.note-1: Every drift class has a stable code and a negative test in test/grace-lint-strict.test.ts.
notes.note-2: Block pairing is name-aware: START_BLOCK_A closed by END_BLOCK_B is an error even when counts match.
notes.note-3: JSON mode emits the ADR-8 envelope and honours the exit code (the v1 always-zero bug is fixed).
notes.note-5: Incremental mode (--changed): git diff base (default HEAD) plus untracked files, or explicit --files without git; index changes trigger full index checks, entity changes only that entity, source changes only markup. `Scope: N changed file(s) (scanned: X, skipped: Y)` is printed and JSON adds data.scope.
notes.note-4: Sharding (ADR-6): graph-index and shard unions are validated like a flat index; shard problems use SHARD_COUNT_MISMATCH, SHARD_FILE_MISSING, SHARD_ROOT_INVALID, PATH_UNSAFE and per-shard INDEX_TOO_LARGE.
